description: This Java source file defines an abstract test class 'BaseWebContextSensitiveTest' that extends 'BaseContextSensitiveTest' to provide web-specific testing utilities in the OpenMRS project. It sets up Spring Web application context configurations for controller testing, specifically including 'openmrs-servlet.xml' and 'AltAuthSchemeTestingApplicationContext.xml'.

classes.name: BaseWebContextSensitiveTest
classes.description: An abstract class for web environment testing in OpenMRS, sets up Spring context configurations and extends 'BaseContextSensitiveTest'.
